d:
Shiv sarkit, bihar – aastha, adhyatm aur prakriti ki divy yatra
Bihar ki pavan dharti par bhagvan shiv ki aaradhna sadiyon se chali aa rahi hai. shiv sarkit keval mandiron ki yatra nahin, balki bihar ki aadhyatmik virasat, prachin paranpraon, pavitr nadiyon aur prakritik saundary ko ek sath anubhav karne ka avsar hai.
